notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.content:
Here's what’s new in Update 2.0:

[list]
[*][b]Visual Enhancements[/b]: Textures, lighting, and effects have been upgraded to create a more immersive world.

[*][b]Improved Camera System[/b]: Enjoy smoother transitions, better angles, and more intuitive camera behavior.

[*][b]Performance Boost[/b]: Reduced load times and optimized engine performance for a faster and more stable experience.

[*][b]Bug Fixes[/b]: We’ve squashed a bunch of annoying bugs to improve stability and gameplay. Sorry speedruners!

[*][b]Music Control[/b]: Take control of your soundtrack – improved volume options.

[*][b]UI Overhaul[/b]: Cleaner, more intuitive interface with improved feedback and accessibility.
[/list]

Thanks for playing – and stay tuned, more is on the way!
